description:
OALabs shows a walk-through of how to unpack a sample malware and explains some basics about packers. You can learn about using x64debug, IDA and PE-Bear.

LEARN ON HEXTREE (ad)
Learn hacking on Hextree: https://www.hextree.io/
Join the Hextree Discord: https://discord.gg/xgQpCQCpvy

OALabs: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC--DwaiMV-jtO-6EvmKOnqg

CHAPTERS
00:00 - OALabs Introduces Redaman Malware
01:25 - Self-Injection and PE Section Overwrite
04:55 - Preparing the Malware Analysis VM
05:45 - Breaking on VirtualAlloc and VirtualProtect
08:12 - Finding and Dumping the First PE Payload
10:02 - Validating the Dump and Confirming PE Overwrite
12:55 - Identifying a Packed Second Stage in IDA
14:45 - XOR Decryption, Decompression, and Dynamic APIs
17:15 - Writing and Loading the Temporary DLL
19:33 - Extracting the DLL with a LoadLibraryW Breakpoint
21:53 - Revealing the Hidden DLL with attrib
23:10 - Inspecting the Unpacked DLL and Remaining Obfuscation
24:53 - Self-Injection Unpacking Workflow Recap
